name: AirLock — Discord VC Manager
author: contact@hrxshx.com
description: ꒰ঌ AirLock ໒꒱ — a cute, aesthetic join-to-create Discord voice-channel manager with moderation (kick/ban/quarantine, voice-ban), owner control panel, DISBOARD bump reminders and a pixel-art banner. Built with discord.js v14 + @napi-rs/canvas.
startup: if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]] && [[ -d .git ]]; then echo "[AirLock] pulling updates..."; git pull; fi; if [ ! -d /home/container/node_modules ] || [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]]; then echo "[AirLock] installing dependencies..."; npm install --omit=dev; fi; node /home/container/${MAIN_FILE}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# AirLock — Discord VC Manager · Pterodactyl install script
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "[1/4] Installing git..."
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ]; then
    echo "[2/4] USER_UPLOAD enabled — skipping git clone. Upload your own files to the server."
else
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "[2/4] No GIT_ADDRESS set and USER_UPLOAD is off — nothing to fetch."
    else
        # normalise the address (allow with or without .git)
        if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then
            GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
        fi
        if [ -d .git ]; then
            echo "[2/4] Existing repository found — pulling latest changes..."
            git pull
        else
            echo "[2/4] Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch ${BRANCH:-main})..."
            git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        fi
    fi
fi

echo "[3/4] npm version: $(npm -v) / node version: $(node -v)"

if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "[4/4] Installing Node.js dependencies (this can take 1-3 min for canvas)..."
    npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=info --progress=false
else
    echo "WARNING: no package.json found — did the clone/upload succeed?"
fi

echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
echo "  AirLock install complete!"
echo "  -> Set DISCORD_TOKEN in the server's Startup tab."
echo "  -> Leave GUILD_ID blank for a public (global) bot."
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Your bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot > Reset Token). Keep this secret!

variables.name: Guild ID (optional)
variables.description: A server ID for INSTANT slash-command registration during testing. Leave BLANK for a public bot (global sync, can take up to ~1 hour to appear).

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: The git repo the bot code is pulled from on install/update. Change this if you fork it.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set to 1 if you want to upload your own files instead of cloning from git. 0 = clone from the repo above.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Set to 1 to git-pull and reinstall dependencies on every restart. 0 = start faster, update manually.

variables.name: Main File
variables.description: The entry file the bot runs.
